card.name: Decimal point in Use in Specific Populations citations
card.fires_on: Mainly the period inside section cross-references like (8.4, 8.5) after 'Use in Specific Populations'. It also fires weakly on a few scattered words such as 'that', 'left' and 'get'.

modes.label: Section number point
modes.description: The period between 8 and the subsection digit in a 'see Use in Specific Populations (8.x)' reference.
modes.example: It is not necessary to adjust the dose in the elderly [see use in Specific Populations ( 8<<.>>5 )]. CYP2D6

modes.label: Scattered words
modes.description: Isolated linking or direction words in ordinary instructions or forum text.
modes.example: Place the patient in the<< left>>-side position or the knee-chest position
